question: Compare cognitive test scores between Alzheimer's patients and controls (n=50 each). Perform t-test and compute Cohen's d with 95% CI (via bootstrapping with 10,000 iterations using random seed 42). Return the mean difference, p-value, Cohen's d, and interpret the effect size (small/medium/large).

expected_output.description: rows as test result (1 row), columns should include Mean_Difference, P_Value, Cohens_d, CI_Lower, CI_Upper, Effect_Size_Interpretation
